mapper.sql: p.id, p.author_id, u.display_name AS author_name, p.title, p.content, p.tags::text AS tags, p.related_course, p.related_location, p.status, p.likes, p.reports, p.reject_reason, p.created_at, p.reviewed_at, p.updated_at
mapper.select: WITH inserted AS ( INSERT INTO ugc_post ( author_id, title, content, tags, related_course, related_location, status, likes, reports ) VALUES ( #{authorId}, #{post.title}, #{post.content}, #{post.tagsJson, typeHandler=xyz.v185v.collegeassistant.persistence.typehandler.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, #{post.relatedCourse, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{post.relatedLocation, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PENDING', 0, 0 ) RETURNING id, author_id, title, content, tags, related_course, related_location, status, likes, reports, reject_reason, created_at, reviewed_at, updated_at ) SELECT i.id, i.author_id, u.display_name AS author_name, i.title, i.content, i.tags::text AS tags, i.related_course, i.related_location, i.status, i.likes, i.reports, i.reject_reason, i.created_at, i.reviewed_at, i.updated_at FROM inserted i JOIN users u ON u.id = i.author_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ugc_post p WHERE (#{authorId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL OR p.author_id = #{authorId, jdbcType=BIGINT}) AND (#{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR p.status = #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND (#{tagJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR p.tags @> CAST(#{tagJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb))

SELECT FROM ugc_post p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id WHERE (#{authorId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL OR p.author_id = #{authorId, jdbcType=BIGINT}) AND (#{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR p.status = #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND (#{tagJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR p.tags @> CAST(#{tagJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb)) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM ugc_post p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id WHERE p.id = #{id}

WITH updated AS ( UPDATE ugc_post SET status = 'REMOVED', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} RETURNING id, author_id, title, content, tags, related_course, related_location, status, likes, reports, reject_reason, created_at, reviewed_at, updated_at ) SELECT u.id, u.author_id, a.display_name AS author_name, u.title, u.content, u.tags::text AS tags, u.related_course, u.related_location, u.status, u.likes, u.reports, u.reject_reason, u.created_at, u.reviewed_at, u.updated_at FROM updated u JOIN users a ON a.id = u.author_id
SELECT FROM ugc_post p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.status = 'APPROVED'
INSERT INTO ugc_like (post_id, user_id) SELECT p.id, #{userId} FROM ugc_post p WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.status = 'APPROVED' ON CONFLICT (post_id, user_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING post_id

INSERT INTO ugc_report (post_id, reporter_id, reason) SELECT p.id, #{reporterId}, #{reason} FROM ugc_post p WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.status = 'APPROVED' ON CONFLICT (post_id, reporter_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING post_id

SELECT r.id, r.post_id, r.reporter_id, u.display_name AS reporter_name, r.reason, r.status, r.reviewer_id, r.created_at, r.resolved_at FROM ugc_report r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.reporter_id WHERE r.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

WITH updated AS ( UPDATE ugc_report SET status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, resolved_at = now() WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND id = #{reportId} AND status = 'OPEN' RETURNING id, post_id, reporter_id, reason, status, reviewer_id, created_at, resolved_at ) SELECT r.id, r.post_id, r.reporter_id, u.display_name AS reporter_name, r.reason, r.status, r.reviewer_id, r.created_at, r.resolved_at FROM updated r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.reporter_id
SELECT status FROM ugc_post WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ugc_post p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id WHERE p.status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY p.id ASC
SELECT FROM ugc_post p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.status = 'APPROVED' FOR UPDATE OF p

SELECT p.id FROM ugc_post p WHERE p.status = 'APPROVED' AND p.id > #{afterId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM embedding_chunk c WHERE c.doc_ref_type = 'UGC' AND c.source_type = 'UGC' AND c.doc_ref_id = p.id ) ORDER BY p.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH updated AS ( UPDATE ugc_post SET status = #{status}, reviewed_by = #{reviewerId}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, reviewed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' RETURNING id, author_id, title, content, tags, related_course, related_location, status, likes, reports, reject_reason, created_at, reviewed_at, updated_at ) SELECT u.id, u.author_id, a.display_name AS author_name, u.title, u.content, u.tags::text AS tags, u.related_course, u.related_location, u.status, u.likes, u.reports, u.reject_reason, u.created_at, u.reviewed_at, u.updated_at FROM updated u JOIN users a ON a.id = u.author_id
